style: Editorial cocktail photograph for a fantasy potion bar menu. Setting: dark aged oak bar counter in an alchemist's apothecary, blurred background of wooden shelves with old amber and green glass apothecary bottles and a few candles, faint wisps of smoke in the air. Lighting: low-key, warm candlelight from the left, rim light on the glass, deep shadows, rich contrast. Camera: 85mm, f/2, eye level, the vessel centered and filling about 60% of the frame, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, a real cocktail, no text, no labels, no people, no hands.

potions.invis: A round-bottom glass alchemy flask with a long narrow neck, filled with a deep indigo-blue butterfly pea gin and tonic with clear ice, a small lemon wedge resting on the counter beside it.
potions.invis-pink: EDIT of invis.jpg: keep everything identical, only the drink inside the flask is now a vivid magenta-pink, as if lemon juice changed its colour.
potions.dragon: A heavy crystal rocks glass with an amber mezcal cocktail and one large clear ice cube, a dried red chili and a charred pineapple wedge on the rim, topped by a large translucent soap-like bubble filled with white smoke resting on the rim.
potions.swamp: A coupe glass with a pale green absinthe and basil cocktail standing under a glass cloche dome filled with swirling white rosemary smoke, a rosemary sprig on the counter.
potions.mermaid: A tall teardrop-shaped glass vial filled with an iridescent turquoise-blue rum and curacao cocktail with swirling edible pearl shimmer, a few tiny shells on the counter.
potions.mandrake: An ornate antique pewter goblet with a deep ruby-red beet, ginger and bourbon cocktail, a small gnarled root shaped like a tiny man on a wooden skewer as garnish.
potions.powder: A glass Erlenmeyer laboratory flask with a dark amber whisky and coffee cocktail, an orange peel twist, a smouldering cinnamon stick in it releasing a thin trail of smoke.
potions.moonwater: A small glass apothecary bottle with a cork stopper beside a short glass, both with violet-blue butterfly pea elderflower lemonade, a sprig of elderflowers, a tiny crescent moon charm hanging on twine around the bottle neck.
potions.moonwater-pink: EDIT of moonwater.jpg: keep everything identical, only the lemonade is now soft rose-pink.
potions.basilisk: A tall highball glass with a vivid emerald-green apple and cucumber soda, lots of ice and rising bubbles, a long rosemary sprig and a thin cucumber ribbon.
potions.wyvern: A stemmed glass with a golden passion fruit and tequila cocktail, a rim of black volcanic salt, a thin slice of green jalapeño floating on top.
potions.phoenix: A footed glass goblet with a glowing orange rum cocktail, a flaming orange peel and a star anise on top with a small real flame, sparks in the air.
potions.barrow: A wide round glass bowl with a honey-gold scotch cocktail sitting on a bed of dry ice, thick white fog spilling over the edges and across the bar counter.
potions.fairy: A tall champagne flute with a pale rose-pink sparkling elderflower lemonade with shimmering edible glitter swirling inside, a few rose petals on the counter.
